test: AuraMusic Projectivy home-screen previews on physical Chromecast

assertions.details: Pre-install APK hash differed despite same version code. In-place candidate install preserved app data; pulling the installed base.apk afterward exactly matched the tested candidate hash.

Projectivy stayed foreground. DPAD focus only. Focused card preserved its art and showed pink waveform; Projectivy AudioTrack started at 44.1kHz. Synchronized H.264/AAC screen+device-output capture; WAV RMS 6501.74.
DPAD focus only. Projectivy AudioTrack started at 44.1kHz; synchronized H.264/AAC capture; WAV RMS 3535.15. Pink waveform was present in all 479 sampled frames with 455 distinct row profiles.
20 no-Select focus transitions between two real AuraMusic cards. Launcher foreground, correct row/card, visible waveform, audio active, no multiple Projectivy tracks, no AuraMusic overlap.
DPAD focus loss stopped preview; return to same title restarted Projectivy audio and animated indicator, no overlap.
Focused real card held for 65.25 seconds; 7/7 checks show exact card focused, Projectivy foreground, Projectivy AudioTrack active, indicator visible and changing.
Select launched AuraMusic TvMainActivity; app media session metadata showed click / C418 and PlaybackState PLAYING. The track was then paused; Projectivy was restored.
After tests and ADB capture-server shutdown, WSL ADB still sees the explicit Chromecast serial. Projectivy is foreground with Wending card focused and preview AudioTrack active.

Chromecast rebooted without data clearing. Android 14/API34 boot completed; AuraMusic v29 and accessibility grant persisted. Projectivy relaunched, AuraMusic row remained published; DPAD focus restored waveform and Projectivy AudioTrack.
Projectivy force-stopped/relaunched; AuraMusic channel persisted and focus returned to a card with preview.
A point-in-time snapshot only; growth/eviction trend not established.

On Chromecast API34/Projectivy 4.73, PreviewProbe TvProvider add A/B and remove-to-B each converged to the correct visible row. B/A/C reorder plus add was visible in exact order after Projectivy restart. Probe row A-E and AuraMusic Ancestry focus were restored. Projectivy stayed foreground for all home captures; no Select was pressed. This is a test-publisher boundary check; AuraMusic-specific isolated metadata mutation is not fully covered.

Optimized APK exact hash installed. 67 JVM tests and one focused Chromecast view instrumentation test pass. Connected AndroidTest removed the target package; reinstall had no backup restore and the AuraMusic Quick Picks channel is absent. New Projectivy real-song focus/audio/wave integration has not been reverified.

On current Chromecast install, Projectivy stayed foreground; focus A/B started distinct Projectivy-owned 44.1 kHz AudioTracks; focus loss left no started Projectivy track. scrcpy 4.1 failed its server handshake, so 440/880 Hz identity was not measured. PreviewProbe C screenshots did not change.

testInfraNotes: The tested APK was installed in place with adb install -r; no app data was cleared. Previous installed APK was preserved.

Windows ADB capture used a temporary server on port 5039 with the already-authorized Linux ADB key. A first attempt on port 5038 showed an authorization prompt; it was canceled, no new key was approved, and that server was disconnected. Port 5039 was shut down after capture.
No other physical device was targeted.

Compare optimized candidate CPU/memory against the real-preview baseline
Device-level external media/server/network failure and recovery

latestInstalledCandidate.reason: Fresh install had no backup restore; prior local listening history and AuraMusic channel absent. PreviewProbe A/B confirms active launcher tracks only; physical tone identity and optimized real-song animation remain unverified.

publicEvidenceNote: Screen-only MP4s have their song audio stream removed before publication. Raw device WAV and original screen+audio captures remain local and are referenced in local evidence only.
